sections.title: Performance
items: Pretty drastically improved performance with status and target checks, should help on larger pulls and weaker hardware.

sections.title: Fixes
items: "/rotation Auto 1" now selects the targeting type by its position in your list.
DoActions and rotation setting commands read decimal times correctly on systems that use a decimal comma.
The random target delay is no longer always the shortest value.
"Hide all warnings" setting actually works now lol.
Corrupted settings files are now backed up before defaults replace them.

sections.title: Misc core things
items: Built against the latest dalamud version, updated sourcegen, and updated UI to fix a few bugs.
